_doc: Mimir autonomy loop config (spec 09 §7.1, task_triage at PROPOSE). The JUDGMENT is deterministic and lives here: the subject-domain -> TaskWarrior-project map, the daily cap, the stale threshold. NO LLM. Tuning needs no code change. Endpoints are overridable so the tools stay host-portable.
_provenance_doc: provenance = min(producer, item source). The producer (systemd, owner infra) is trusted; a proposal inherits the WEAKER of that and its item's authoring source. plaud/claude = owner voice/session = trusted. Anything absent here defaults to untrusted (fail-safe: Override B holds it at propose forever).
_route_gating_doc: Producer-side PRECISION filters for route_to_tw candidates (spec 09 §7.1, added 2026-07-25). DETERMINISTIC, no LLM. These ONLY narrow which captured items become individual route proposals; they NEVER touch the gate, needs_human, tiers, trust, bulk_archive_stale, or execution — every emitted row is still status='proposed'/needs_human with can_auto=false at 0% trust. Diagnosis that motivated them: 50% of the captured pool is assignee=other (the producer ignored assignee entirely), and route candidates used the 60d BULK threshold as their freshness window, so month-old already-handled meeting action items were routed. Loosen/tighten here; no code change.

exclude_action_regexes: ^\s*(discuss|align on|talk about|touch base|catch up|sync up|chat about|brainstorm)\b

_map_doc: subject-domain (task_queue.domain on the CAPTURED item) -> TW project. A captured item whose domain is not a key here is NOT deterministically routable and is left for the owner (never guessed).
_prio_doc: captured-item priority (1..5) -> TaskWarrior priority (H/M/L). Passthrough of intent, not a re-rank.
